title: AP Royal Oak Jumbo in titanium and metal glass, red dial
why: OWNER REQUEST (2026-11-27): a post about the Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 'Jumbo' Extra-Thin in titanium with the red ('smoked burgundy') dial, ref 16202XT.OO.1240XT.01. The cool part: its polished bezel and centre bracelet links are bulk metallic glass (BMG), a palladium alloy cooled so fast its atoms never line up into crystals, so it is a metal built like glass. Owner exception: the COVER is the watch itself (official AP product photo, red dial, big and tight), not a movement shot. Suggested slides, plain words, one idea each: 1 cover, twist headline 'Metal That Acts Like Glass' (or similar 3-5 words), meta 'AP Royal Oak Jumbo · titanium'; 2 the red dial fades from red to black; 3 what metal glass is, in one sentence; 4 where it is: the shiny bezel and middle links, the rest brushed titanium; 5 how thin: 8.1 mm thick, 39 mm wide; 6 it started as a one-off watch for the Only Watch charity auction in 2021; 7 cta 'Red dial or classic blue? Comment below.' Price: AP lists it as price on request, so no price on slides (never use dealer prices). Photos: AP's official product images from the AP page below via photo.js (official rights); a second angle or bracelet shot from AP if available. Sources go only in the caption's bottom Source line.
